system.description: This small fragment of ghost-white marble has been lashed to a crude leather thong, ideal for tying around the forehead as a headband. The fragment of stone still bears a rune or two of ancient high elf script, inlaid in silver. Encumbrance: Trivial The wearer of the Brain Rock receives occasional flashes of insight and knowledge and may see the future. This can be very confusing. He adds {Dc} to Intelligence checks. This item is Attuned 2 to the wind of Azyr. Wizards who use Azyr add their {De} to Channel Power and cast spells.
